answer: Deposits are visible in delta, and bridge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 26 aliases, and each one needs its own funded inlet account. A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. A farm of 3535 identities would post 4758 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
